title: price_proposal event
description: A spoken price that differs from the price of a priced card. Shown to the seller in the console only; it never changes the card (D-023, D-024).

ts_ms.description: Source time (epoch ms) of what the event describes, not processing time

caused_by.description: event_ids this event is a consequence of (provenance, C1/C6)

timing.description: Optional stage timestamps (epoch ms) for latency measurement (C8)

card_version.description: Version of the card when the price was heard

current_price.description: Price on that version (integer VND); a card whose price is null takes the spoken price directly (D-023), so it never gets a proposal

heard_price.description: Price heard in the speech (integer VND)

speech_event_id.description: The speech event that carried the price; also listed in caused_by
